sales_hooks: Meta $64-72B CapEx 2026 — raised guidance 3x in 18 months; Zuckerberg publicly committed to 'not losing the AI race', making HBM procurement a board-level priority.
Meta's open-source Llama model strategy means every GPU cluster Meta builds gets replicated by thousands of fine-tuners worldwide — Meta is both a direct HBM customer and an HBM demand multiplier.
Meta is the largest buyer of NVIDIA H100s that is NOT a cloud provider — unique procurement dynamics: no resale margin, direct ROI tied to ad targeting performance.

MTIA v2 custom chip handles inference without NVIDIA; if MTIA scales, Meta's HBM procurement path shifts from NVIDIA-intermediated to direct — a threat or an opportunity depending on your supplier's direct sales relationship.
